leadText: Gracia (Japanese: ガラシャ) is a Warlord in Pokémon Conquest.
plainText:
Gracia (Japanese: ガラシャ) is a Warlord in Pokémon Conquest.

==In the games==

===Quotes===
Start of turn:
When asleep:
"Hey! Wake up!"
With low health or a status ailment: 
"Uh-oh..."
When victory is near:
"I think we can win this!"
Otherwise: 
"Let's go!"

Start of battle:
When attacking a castle: 
"Tell me—do you have what it takes?"
When defending a castle: 
"Nobody's taking this castle from us!"

During battle: 
"There's still so much about the world I don't know, ! I want to know more! More!"

When ordering to attack: 
" ! Now's your chance!"

When ordering to go to battle:
To a kingdom:
"I'm gonna do my very best!"
To a wild Pokémon location:
"I wonder what's waiting for us!"

Upon forming a link: 
"So... ! I've got high hopes for you!"

When using an item: 
"I still have my !"

When using her Warrior Skill: 
"See how you like this!"

After winning a battle: 
If she attacked a castle:
"Hey! We did it! I think I did pretty well too!"
If she defended a castle:
"Hmm, did I do something wrong?"

When defeated:
If recruitable:
"Oh, well... Looks like we just can't compete!"
If defeated by something other than the enemy:
"Oh! What a shock..."
Otherwise:
"Oh... How disappointing..."
"Oh... How depressing."

When being recruited:
"You look like a bright spark! I'll come along with you!"

When the player's army has conquered 10 kingdoms:
" 's army is getting to be really first rate! Guess we've gotta do something about it..."

When delegating:
Before a delegation is chosen:
"What shall I take care of for you?"
After a delegation is chosen:
""Leave it all up to me!"
When a delegation is stopped:
"Oh... Changed your mind?"

When mining:
When about to mine:
"So this is the place to look, right?"
When successful in mining:
"Yes!"
"Yee-hah!"
"Great!"
When unsuccessful in mining:
"Oh no..."

At the start of :
"So... You want me to become a Warlord and help you unite all of Ransei, Father?"
"Oh... So I would have to do battle without you, Father...?"
"I'll do it! I've always wanted to visit other kingdoms!"
"With you telling me never to leave the castle, I hardly ever get the chance to travel."
"But this contest will let me travel as much as I want!"

At the end of :
"I did it! I'm number one!"
"Father!"
"What?! You're telling me off now, of all times?!"

===Profile===
Mitsuhide's daughter is innocent and curious and cannot wait to learn more about the mysteries of the world. 

==In the manga==
===Pokémon + Nobunaga's Ambition ~ Ranse's Color Picture Scroll ~===
Gracia debuted in PNA4.
 
====Pokémon====
 

==Trivia==

===Historical origin===
Gracia is based on the real-life of Japanese history, who was Mitsuhide ( )'s daughter. She was married to Tadaoki ( ).

Her Ice specialty may be a reference to her father Mitsuhide.
